summary: Temporary drone danger area at Millbrook, Southampton, with drone flights limited to 400 feet above ground, daily from 0800 to 0400.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD182B INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
505534N 0012653W (MILLBROOK, SOUTHAMPTON). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF 
SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG 
SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL 
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT 
UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OF 
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR 
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPR ARE REMINDED OF 
THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE 
PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK.
DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC DFR(AT)HAMPSHIRE.POLICE.UK. 
AR-2026-4167/07.
